short_description.value: Learn, track progress, and volunteer through structured courses & tasks.

full_description.value:
Yarim Oy is an educational and productivity platform that helps aspiring volunteers and learners build skills through structured courses, interactive lessons, downloadable materials, and performance tracking.

KEY FEATURES
• Multi-language support (English, Russian, Uzbek – Latin & Cyrillic)
• Secure account-based access (login required)
• Browse and enroll in structured course modules
• Watch lessons (video-enabled) and read learning content
• Track lesson and task completion progress
• Download course files for offline viewing
• Leaderboard & productivity score to motivate engagement
• View personal statistics: completed courses, tasks, productivity score
• In-app notifications for updates and progress events
• Feedback section for user input and improvement
• Profile customization (avatar, name, username, region)
• FAQ & guidelines for onboarding

WHO IS IT FOR?
Learners, volunteers, and organizations seeking structured growth, engagement, and tracking.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Sign in with your account
2. Select a course and start lessons
3. Complete tasks and track progress
4. Earn productivity-based placement in leaderboards
5. Download materials for flexible study

PRIVACY & SAFETY
We collect only essential account and usage data (e.g., username, avatar, progress) to provide core functionality. No financial, health, or sensitive biometric data is collected.

NO ADS – NO IN-APP PURCHASES
Focused experience without monetization distractions.

LANGUAGES SUPPORTED
English (en), Russian (ru), Uzbek (uz-Latn & uz-Cyrl)

Stay productive, keep learning, and grow through structured pathways with Yarim Oy.
